review_candidates.title: Construction Site Manager
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Site Manager (Civil/Mechanical) Are you a seasoned construction professional with extensive experience managing civil and mechanical construction works on large-scale EPC projects? We are looking for an accomplished Site Manager to lead and oversee all on-site civil and mechanical construction activities, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality project execution. The Site Manager will be responsible for managing the day-to-day delivery of civil and mechanical construction packages, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, enforcing HSE and quality standards, and driving projects toward successful completion. The role will also work closely with operational leadership and project stakeholders to ensure construction objectives are achieved safely, on schedule, and within budget. YOUR ROLE Civil & Mechanical Construction Leadership Lead and manage all on-site civil and mechanical construction activities in accordance with approved project plans, specifications, and schedules. Oversee construction works including foundations, concrete structures, buildings, underground services, steel structures, mechanical equipment installation, piping systems, tanks, vessels, and associated infrastructure. Coordinate interfaces between civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and commissioning teams to ensure seamless project execution. Ensure construction activities are executed in compliance with project requirements, industry standards, and client specifications. Site Planning & Project Execution Develop and implement site logistics, mobilization, and construction execution plans. Coordinate manpower, equipment, materials, and subcontractors to maximize productivity. Monitor progress against project milestones and implement recovery plans where required. Conduct site assessments to identify construction, safety, environmental, and logistical requirements. Quality Assurance & Control Ensure all civil and mechanical works comply with approved drawings, specifications, codes, and standards. Conduct regular inspections and quality audits to verify workmanship and compliance. Collaborate with QA/QC teams to address non-conformances and implement corrective actions. Maintain accurate construction and quality documentation. Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Compliance Promote and enforce a strong HSE culture across all construction activities. Conduct safety briefings, toolbox talks, and site inspections. Ensure compliance with company, client, and regulatory HSE requirements. Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions while implementing preventive measures. Resource & Team Management Lead site engineers, supervisors, foremen, subcontractors, and construction crews. Monitor workforce performance and productivity. Coordinate material deliveries, equipment utilization, and construction sequencing. Facilitate regular site meetings and progress reviews. Stakeholder Management & Reporting Serve as the primary on-site contact for Project Directors, construction management teams, and client representatives. Provide regular updates on construction progress, productivity, risks, and key project metrics. Maintain effective communication with contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders. Support project leadership in achieving strategic project objectives. Risk Management & Problem Solving Identify and mitigate construction risks related to safety, quality, schedule, and cost. Resolve technical and operational issues that impact project execution. Implement lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Experience Minimum 12 years of construction and project management experience within: Oil & Gas EPC Projects Industrial Plants Refineries & Petrochemical Facilities Power Generation Projects Marine & Infrastructure Developments Minimum 5 years in a Site Manager, Construction Manager, or Project Leadership role overseeing major civil and mechanical construction works. Proven experience managing large multidisciplinary construction teams and subcontractors. Education and Certifications Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related Engineering discipline . Master's Degree in Engineering Management or Project Management is preferred. PMP or equivalent Project Management Certification is preferred. OSHA or other recognized Safety Management Certifications are advantageous. Skills and Competencies Strong expertise in civil and mechanical construction management within EPC environments. Extensive knowledge of: Structural and civil construction, Mechanical equipment installation, Piping and process systems, Construction methodologies, International construction codes and standards. Strong understanding of HSE regulations and best practices. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and construction documents. Excellent leadership, organizational, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency in project planning, scheduling, reporting, and construction management software. WHAT WE OFFER The chance to contribute to some of UAE’s Oil and Gas EPC Mega projects. A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. Opportunities for professional growth and career progression. Competitive salary and benefits package. Ready to be part of our team? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success. Apply today and be part of something excellent!

review_candidates.title: Conducteur de travaux - Exploitation du réseau urbain (h/f)
review_candidates.description: Contexte La Direction Espace Public Voirie (DEPV) est gestionnaire d’un réseau de 3500 km de voirie, de fonctions très différentes, et de plus de 35 millions de m² d’espaces publics. Ces espaces sont confrontés à des enjeux de sécurité, de préservation et de mutation pour accueillir d’autres formes de mobilité et d’usages. Ils doivent accompagner les multiples projets de développement de la Métropole et contribuer à son attractivité. Vous intègrerez le service d’entretien et d’exploitation des routes (S.E.E.R.) qui est un des services centraux de la DEPV. Il est spécifiquement chargé de la gestion patrimoniale des axes routiers structurants et des interventions urgentes sur l’ensemble du réseau, que ces interventions soient réalisées en régie ou en faisant appel à des entreprises. Pour relever ces enjeux, le S.E.E.R. et notamment le centre est organisé autour de 2 Unités Fonctionnelles, dont celle du réseau urbain chargée de la maintenance , d’intervention rapide et de sécurisation en agglomération. C’est donc au sein de cette unité fonctionnelle que vous évoluerez. Le SEER recherche un conducteur de travaux , acteur clé de la conception, de l’organisation et de la réalisation de ses opérations. Missions Vous souhaitez occuper un poste opérationnel, au cœur du terrain, avec des responsabilités techniques, administratives et financières sur des chantiers de voirie et de signalisation sur le domaine urbain ? Vos Missions Préparer et coordonner les opérations Élaborer les dossiers d’opérations (techniques, administratifs et financiers) Rédiger les pièces techniques à partir du dossier d’études (DE, BPU, CCTP) Organiser et coordonner l’ensemble des acteurs de l’opération : réunions de chantier, comptes-rendus, plannings Piloter et suivre les chantiers Vous Assurez La Responsabilité Technique, Administrative Et Financière D’un Ou Plusieurs Chantiers, Jusqu’à La Garantie De Parfait Achèvement Planifier et coordonner les entreprises et les différents intervenants Veiller au respect de la signalisation, des normes et des procédures de sécurité et d’hygiène Vérifier la conformité des travaux aux plans et au cahier des charges Contrôler les implantations et adapter le projet aux contraintes de terrain Étudier les difficultés rencontrées et proposer des solutions adaptées Assurer la circulation de l’information entre tous les intervenants Établir les métrés contradictoires et constats de travaux Suivre la commande et la facturation (logiciel Grand Angle), et mettre à jour les tableaux de bord (logiciel Phénix) Gérer les relations avec les communes, riverains, usagers et partenaires institutionnels Missions spécifiques et urgences Instruire les dossiers de demandes d’entretien et de maintenance du réseau (GRU – DIVA) Participer aux interventions urgentes et opérations de maintenance du réseau, y compris hors horaires habituels Assurer la continuité de service via astreintes ou permanences pour la viabilité hivernale, la sécurité des chaussées et la maintenance des équipements de signalisation Autres Particularités Sujétions horaires exceptionnelles liées à la surveillance de travaux en dehors des horaires normaux de travail : Le conducteur de travaux est susceptible de surveiller des travaux en horaires décalés (notamment la nuit), pour nécessité de service. Le cas échéant, il perçoit des indemnités d’heures supplémentaires. Disponibilité importante (participation aux astreintes Accident et viabilité hivernale : service de nuit, week-ends et jours fériés), une proximité du lieu d’affectation est souhaitée. Profil Vous souhaitez occuper un poste technique, concret et stratégique, où votre travail a un impact direct sur le réseau urbain. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en réglementation voirie, sécurité et infrastructures vous permettant d’assurer le pilotage de chantiers. Vous maîtrisez la conduite de chantier , de la planification et du pilotage d’entreprises externes. Vous êtes habitué au travail en équipe et en transversalité permettant de collaborer efficacement avec les services internes, les communes et les partenaires extérieurs. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils bureautiques et maîtrisez les logiciels métiers, notamment Grand Angle et Phénix, afin d’assurer un suivi administratif et financier rigoureux des opérations. Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de réactivité et de capacité d’anticipation. Votre disponibilité et votre aisance relationnelle vous permettent de gérer efficacement les relations avec les entreprises, les élus, les partenaires et les usagers. Permis B requis Classification RIFSEEP : 3.2 Poste basé au sein du Centre exploitation du réseau urbain Lille Seclin (rue des Epoux Labrousse à Villeneuve d’Ascq) Habilitations / Permis AIPR concepteur souhaitée Permis B obligatoire : déplacements quotidiens Poste éligible au télétravail : oui Modalités d'exercice La Métropole Européenne de Lille lutte contre toutes les formes de discrimination, vise à diversifier ses candidatures et reconnaît tous les talents. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Ce poste est à pourvoir le plus rapidement possible. Merci d’adresser votre candidature (lettre de motivation et cv) à l’attention de Monsieur le Président.

review_candidates.description: We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation. Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet. Location & Team Gatherings Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON. We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture. About This Role As part of Intersect’s Development Engineering team, you’ll provide civil and structural guidance that turns early concepts into buildable, code-compliant designs for grid-scale solar, storage, and compute-adjacent data center sites. You’ll set clear design criteria, optimize layouts for land and cost efficiency, and coordinate technical diligence so projects move from site control through Issued for Construction (IFC) with fewer surprises. You’ll work as an individual contributor while partnering closely with Development, Real Estate, Permitting, Construction, Finance, and external A/E consultants, EPC partners and general contractors. Your work ensures safe, timely, and cost-effective delivery. Team Overview The Development Engineering team transforms vision into reality. By owning the civil and structural foundations of project design from early due diligence through Issued for Construction (IFC) and into construction support we de-risk land, permitting, cost, and schedule so Intersect can scale clean energy infrastructure at speed. Our work blends deep technical rigor with practical project management, in close collaboration with EPC partners, consultants, utilities, and internal teams to ensure seamless delivery. Joining this team means contributing directly to Intersect’s mission of powering a sustainable future while growing your expertise in large-scale power project execution. What You’ll Do Set the design criteria & align stakeholders Collaborate with internal teams, hyperscalers, external consultants, and AHJs to define and develop civil and structural design criteria aligned with project goals and regulatory requirements Provide civil engineering direction and oversight for data center-adjacent power facilities, coordinating closely with A/E consultants and general contractors Advance project development & manage risk Support project development from concept to completion, identifying and mitigating design, budget, and schedule risks with a civil-engineering focus Translate commercial, permitting, and site constraints into clear engineering guidance and decision-ready documentation Optimize layouts for land, cost & permitting Optimize civil site layouts for efficient land use, considering equipment selection, topography, environmental constraints, and permitting requirements Balance constructability, cost, and schedule while iterating designs to reduce risk and improve outcomes Run technical diligence & surveys Manage and coordinate site technical diligence, including hydrology, geotechnical, and transportation studies Procure boundary/topographic surveys and crossing/encroachment matrices; coordinate crossing locations with utilities, landowners, and other stakeholders Deliver integrated civil & structural design Lead engineering consultants and general contractors through constraint mapping, civil and structural design, value engineering, and design reviews Ensure designs comply with relevant codes, industry standards, and project specifications, maintaining clear, review-ready documentation Coordinate across disciplines Work closely with Wind, PV, BESS, Data Center, and High-Voltage engineering teams to resolve interfaces and deliver integrated designs Support permitting & approvals Assist in obtaining development and construction permits, ensuring compliance with local regulations and expediting approvals Enable procurement & contracting Support value engineering and prepare civil/structural scope and contract exhibits, ensuring cost-effective solutions aligned with project specifications What You’ll Bring A bachelor’s degree in civil or structural engineering or equivalent experience that prepares you to guide complex site designs 7+ years of technical civil/structural design experience, including 2+ years leading multidisciplinary design processes for utility-scale power projects Strong command of design development, construction methods, relevant codes and standards, and safety fundamentals for large-scale site work Ability to balance design, production, cost, schedule, and land-use considerations; and to clearly explain tradeoffs to diverse audiences Proven project management skills with the judgment to prioritize across multiple, simultaneous projects Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit, and Civil 3D; familiarity with project tools such as Procore and MS Project (or similar) Collaborative communicator who builds trust with internal teams, EPCs, consultants, AHJs, and landowners A growth mindset, curiosity to learn, willingness to mentor peers and drive to improve playbooks and standards Bonus Points Hands-on experience with grading, stormwater management, erosion control, and SWPPP preparation Experience taking projects from early site diligence through construction Total Rewards Compensation: USD$188,000 to USD$200,000 (total compensation includes base salary + bonus) Equity: Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company. Health & wellness: 100% premium coverage for you and your dependents on medical, dental, and vision Time to recharge: Unlimited PTO, plus two company-wide breaks (Fourth of July & end of year) Family support: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, plus 6 additional weeks for birth parents; access to family planning and family care support through Carrot and Maven Mental health: Free access to Spring Health, including 5 free therapy and psychiatry sessions, plus a Headspace account for mindfulness and meditation through our physical health vendor, Wellhub+ Perks & extras: $150 monthly food stipend, $150 monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet, pet insurance allowance, full home office setup, free access to UrbanSitter with $625 in quarterly company-paid credits, ActiveHero, and One Medical Intersect maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling Intersect's commitment to equal employment opportunity. Intersect does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by and consistent with applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. We sometimes use AI-powered note taking tools during interviews to support our team. They're used only for documentation and don't replace human judgment.

Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with diverse stakeholders. Confident to challenge current assumptions and build consensus. review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职责描述： 1.负责SMT电子原物料仓智能WMS系统的开发、实施与运维，对接海柔CTU自动化设备与SAP系统，实现仓库全流程数字化。 2.梳理SMT仓储业务流程，完成需求分析、方案设计、功能开发、测试上线，保障物料收发、库内作业、批次追溯、库存管理的高效与精准。 3.负责WMS与SAP MM/WM/PP模块的接口开发，实现数据实时同步、业务流程闭环，确保库存账实一致。 4.协调海柔CTU厂商、SAP顾问、仓储业务团队，解决设备对接、系统集成中的技术与业务问题。 5.输出项目文档、操作手册、运维方案，开展用户培训，保障系统稳定运行与业务优化迭代。 任职要求： 1.本科及以上，计算机、软件工程、物流工程相关专业，3年及以上相关工作经验（高级岗5年+）。 2.精通Java/Go语言，熟悉Spring Boot微服务、MySQL/Oracle数据库，具备WMS/智能仓储系统开发经验。 3.熟悉海柔CTU设备通信协议、接口开发，有自动化仓储设备对接经验者优先。 4.精通SAP MM/WM/PP模块，熟悉IDOC/RFC/BAPI接口开发，有SAP与第三方系统集成经验者优先。 5.熟悉SMT电子原物料管理流程、物料追溯、批次管理，有电子制造行业经验者优先。 6.具备良好的沟通协调、问题排查能力，能独立推进项目落地，抗压能力强。

review_candidates.title: 整车系统开发工程师
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职位描述 负责三电系统、底盘域控、网关系统架构设计，包括软硬件功能划分、接口定义、通信矩阵及网络拓扑 负责系统需求管理，将整车功能需求分解为系统及软硬件需求，跟踪需求全流程落地与验证 负责底盘域控制器软件架构设计，基于 AUTOSAR（CP/AP）进行分层架构设计、模块划分、接口定义 负责底盘域控制器控制策略、能量管理、诊断刷写、OTA 升级、网络管理等核心模块开发及功能安全开发 负责系统级测试验证，制定系统测试方案，参与台架与整车测试，定位问题并推动整改闭环 职位要求 985、211 本科以上学历车辆工程、电子、自动化相关专业，5 年以上汽车三电系统开发经验 有VCU、MCU、GW、多控制器融合等产品的系统和软件开发经验，两个以上整车量产项目经验 精通 C/C++ 编程语言和Simulink开发，熟悉嵌入式软件开发流程 熟悉 ISO 26262功能安全标准、ASPICE 开发流程经验者加分 具备良好的问题分析能力和团队协作精神，责任心强，能承受一定的工作压力
